title: Sheaves on a localized site as sheaves over a sheafified representable
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $\Sh(\mathcal C)$ its category of sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $U$ be an object and give $\mathcal C/U$ the localized topology [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Write $h_U(X)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(X,U)$ with restriction by precomposition and let $h_U^\#$ be its sheafification with unit $\eta:h_U\to h_U^\#$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. The category $\Sh(\mathcal C)/h_U^\#$ has objects sheaf maps $p:F\to h_U^\#$ and arrows sheaf maps commuting with these maps. There is an equivalence $E_U:\Sh(\mathcal C/U)\simeq\Sh(\mathcal C)/h_U^\#$ whose quasi-inverse sends $(F,p)$ to the sheaf
$$ (X\xrightarrow{a}U)\longmapsto\{s\in F(X):p_X(s)=\eta_X(a)\}, $$
with restrictions induced by those of $F$; on arrows it restricts the component maps to these fibres. Concretely $E_U(H)$ is the sheafification of the presheaf $X\mapsto\coprod_{a:X\to U}H(X\xrightarrow{a}U)$, with restriction $(a,s)\mapsto(a\circ b,H(b)(s))$ along $b:Y\to X$, equipped with its map to $h_U^\#$ induced by $(a,s)\mapsto a$. The equivalence has natural unit and counit isomorphisms. No subcanonical-topology or existence-of-all-fibre-products assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Construct the explicit fibre subfunctor of the restriction of F to C/U. Naturality of p and the sheafification unit preserves fibres. Use Subfunctor.isSheaf_iff: a section locally in the fibre has the required image by separatedness of the restricted sheafified representable. This constructs the fibre sheaf and its functor R on maps.

proof.text: Construct the presheaf Q_H(X) = Σ (a : X → U), H(X,a), its projection to h_U, and the functor P on sheaves and maps. Dependent-pair transport along equal arrows proves the functor laws. Set Efun = P followed by Over.post of presheafToSheaf. The required projection, restriction and arrow formulas are definitional.

source.place: Tag 00Y1 (lemma-essential-image-j-shriek), disjoint-union functor; lemma-describe-j-shriek in Section 00XZ; universal property of sheafification.

proof.text: Construct u_H : H → R Efun(H) by sending s over (X,a) to the sheafification of (a,s). Local injectivity of toSheafify, expressed by Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem in Mathlib, gives an equality cover of pairs. Lift it to C/U and use separatedness of H to prove u_H injective. For local surjectivity, use Presheaf.imageSieve_mem for toSheafify to represent a fibre section locally by (a_i,s_i). Naturality of the projection shows that η(a_i)=η(a) on that slice object. Local injectivity of η gives a further equality cover on which a_i becomes the required structure arrow. Restrict s_i along that arrow to obtain a preimage. Transitivity of the localized topology combines the covers. Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso now proves u_H is an isomorphism; its proof supplies the gluing argument of the original plan.

source.place: Tag 00Y1 (lemma-essential-image-j-shriek), first inverse comparison; agent local-section proof using Tag 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification) and Theorem 00WB (theorem-plus).

proof.text: Construct t : Q_(R(F,p)) → F by forgetting the arrow and use sheafifyLift to construct c : Efun R(F,p) → (F,p). The sheafification universal property proves that c is over h_U#. If two pairs have equal underlying sections, their fibre conditions make the images of their arrows under η equal. Local injectivity of η gives an equality sieve for their arrows; on it the restricted dependent pairs coincide. Thus t is locally injective.

source.place: Tag 00Y1 (lemma-essential-image-j-shriek), second inverse comparison; agent injectivity proof using Tag 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification) and Theorem 00WB (theorem-plus).

proof.text: For s ∈ F(X), local surjectivity of η : h_U → h_U# gives a covering image sieve with representatives a_i for p(s). Naturality of p makes (a_i,s restricted) a fibre pair, proving t is locally surjective. Since toSheafify followed by c equals t, Mathlib local-injectivity and local-surjectivity factorization lemmas transfer both properties to c. Sheaf.isLocallyBijective_iff_isIso makes c.left an isomorphism, and Over.forget reflects it. This includes the separatedness and gluing steps of the local-section argument.

source.place: Tag 00Y1 (lemma-essential-image-j-shriek), second inverse comparison; agent surjectivity proof using Tag 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification).

proof.text: Prove naturality of u by the pair-section formula and toSheafify_naturality. Prove naturality of c using sheafifyMap_sheafifyLift and sheafifyLift_comp; on presheaf pairs both sides just apply the given map to the underlying fibre section. Assemble their natural isomorphisms with Equivalence.mk, which adjusts the unit to satisfy the triangle identities while preserving the explicit forward and inverse functors. The equivalences of sections e and r are identities for these explicit functors, so every remaining formula follows by reflexivity. All constructions and comparison proofs work for an arbitrary Grothendieck topology K on a small category; specialize K to J.toGrothendieck to preserve the module theorem signature.
